newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices steady in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices steady in light trade.

text.p: * Indian government security prices steady in light trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
* Lower call money rates boost buying interest but volumes low as traders remain cautious, they said.
* Buying interest concentrated in securities with maturities between 1999 and 2002, dealers said.
* Buying interest seen in latest auctioned stock, 12.69 percent 2002.

* In latest deals, the 13.40 percent 1999 104.50 stock traded at 104.5 rupees against last traded price of 104.49, 13.80 percent 2002 at 105.65 against 105.60 while 13.50 percent 1997 eases to 101.92 from 101.85.
